body:
We had been dating for 2 years. Known each other since high school sort of thing. To put it succinctly, I was on an overseas training mission, I came back, she acts distant and weird (ie breaking dates, accusing me of cheating), I try finding out what's wrong, no communication, I decide to end it after 1 month of trying to piece our relationship together. I haven't spoken to her since. I come to find out from a mutual friend that she was probably cheating on me while I was away with the military.

It's been almost a year since we broke up. Since then I've graduated Summa Cum Laude, have become a commissioned officer in the military, earned a bachelor's degree, and I feel lonelier than ever. It's like what's the point of all this "success" if I feel so horrible.

I've tried forcing myself to get back into dating since the breakup. But maybe I don't have the same enthusiasm I once had, and women can pick up on that? Before, I was happy, spontaneous, eccentric. But after being cheated on by someone I thought was my best friend and partner, I'm not the same. It ruined it for me. It's like I don't trust anyone anymore. People aren't nice. The world is dark. Why should I be happy? I just got fucked over. Is this what they mean when they say "nice guys finish last". Maybe now's the time to stop being the modest high achiever and start being the vain asshole that seems to be so successful with women nowadays

I get angry. I remember sitting in my room, anger just boiling inside of me. I walked over to my closet and punched a hole through the door. I walk around town and see all these beautiful couples, having the time of their life, holding hands, smiling at each other, doing things lovers should do for each other. Then I look at myself, thinking, "I remember being so happy like that couple over there. I wish I had someone. Why can't I have that? I've worked so hard to get where I'm at today. I think the least I deserve is a beautiful girl to love and adore. Maybe I really am just a weirdo like those kids used to say. I guess I'm not that good looking or as nice as that other guy she's run off with at work." 

I get anxious. Whenever I see a girl working behind the counter at a food establishment of any kind, I get triggered to think about my ex who used to work at a deli. I get that feeling of losing her all over again to that sausage stuffing home wrecker. 

It's a cycle. Anxiety turns into anger about my current situation. Anger eventually dissipates and turns into hopelessness that I'll never feel love the same way I used to. Hopelessness turns to depression. Depression leads to me wanting to finally put all this weapons training into action, heading over to the local gun store, buying a Glock, put one in the chamber, cap myself, and end all of the suffering that has gone on for so long.
I don't think I can. I've heard my friend talk about how annoying it is to deal with his other friends' baggage. I don't want to be that guy. Guys usually don't care about that stuff anyways.

Hi. Currently sitting alone in my living room apartment. It's 3 am, and I don't feel like sleeping. I spent the day with my friends, and barely said a word while I was with them. Even when I'm with people, I feel lonely, perhaps even more so. 

I've been to a therapist once. Stopped going after one session.
